cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(OIDNExternalWebGPU LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(LT_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Light Tracer checkout containing libs/dawn")
set(DAWN_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Modern Dawn source checkout (with build-lt)")
if(NOT DAWN_ROOT AND NOT EXISTS "${LT_ROOT}/libs/dawn/include/webgpu/webgpu.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set LT_ROOT to the Light Tracer checkout")
endif()

if(EMSCRIPTEN)
  configure_file(browser_test.html index.html COPYONLY)
  add_library(lt_webgpu INTERFACE)
  target_link_options(lt_webgpu INTERFACE "-sUSE_WEBGPU=1")
else()
if(DAWN_ROOT)
  add_library(lt_webgpu SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
  set_target_properties(lt_webgpu PROPERTIES
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${DAWN_ROOT}/build-lt/gen/include;${DAWN_ROOT}/include"
    INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS OIDN_WEBGPU_DAWN_MODERN
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${DAWN_ROOT}/build-lt/Release/webgpu_dawn.dll"
    IMPORTED_IMPLIB "${DAWN_ROOT}/build-lt/src/dawn/native/Release/webgpu_dawn.lib")
else()
add_library(lt_webgpu SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(lt_webgpu PROPERTIES
  INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${LT_ROOT}/libs/dawn/include"
  INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS OIDN_WEBGPU_DAWN_LEGACY_NATIVE)
if(WIN32)
  set_target_properties(lt_webgpu PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${LT_ROOT}/libs/dawn/lib/Release/webgpu_dawn.dll"
    IMPORTED_IMPLIB "${LT_ROOT}/libs/dawn/lib/Release/webgpu_dawn.lib")
  if(EXISTS "${LT_ROOT}/libs/dawn/include/windows/dawn/webgpu.h")
    set_target_properties(lt_webgpu PROPERTIES
      INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${LT_ROOT}/libs/dawn/include/windows;${LT_ROOT}/libs/dawn/include"
      INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS OIDN_WEBGPU_DAWN_MODERN)
  endif()
else()
  set_target_properties(lt_webgpu PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${LT_ROOT}/libs/dawn/lib/Release/libwebgpu_dawn${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}")
endif()
endif()
endif()

set(OIDN_STATIC_LIB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_DEVICE_WEBGPU ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
foreach(option CPU SYCL CUDA HIP METAL)
  set(OIDN_DEVICE_${option} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
set(OIDN_FILTER_RT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_FILTER_RTLIGHTMAP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_ENABLE_RTLIGHTMAP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_APPS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_LIBRARY_VERSIONED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_WEBGPU_PROVIDER EXTERNAL CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_WEBGPU_PROVIDER_TARGET lt_webgpu CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_WEBGPU_STANDALONE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OIDN_WEBGPU_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(../.. oidn)

option(OIDN_EXTERNAL_PROFILE "Build native GPU timestamp benchmark (test instrumentation only)" OFF)
if(OIDN_EXTERNAL_PROFILE AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
  add_compile_definitions(OIDN_WEBGPU_PROFILE)
  target_compile_definitions(OpenImageDenoise_device_webgpu PRIVATE OIDN_WEBGPU_PROFILE)
  add_executable(oidn_gpu_bench benchmark.cpp)
  target_compile_features(oidn_gpu_bench PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_definitions(oidn_gpu_bench PRIVATE OIDN_WEBGPU_EXTERNAL_ONLY)
  target_include_directories(oidn_gpu_bench PRIVATE ../.. "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/oidn" ../../external)
  target_link_libraries(oidn_gpu_bench PRIVATE OIDN::WebGPU_RT lt_webgpu)
  if(WIN32)
    add_custom_command(TARGET oidn_gpu_bench POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
      $<TARGET_FILE:lt_webgpu> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:oidn_gpu_bench>)
  endif()
endif()

if(EMSCRIPTEN)
  add_executable(oidn_external_test browser_test.cpp)
  target_compile_options(oidn_external_test PRIVATE -fexceptions)
  target_link_options(oidn_external_test PRIVATE -fexceptions
    "-sMODULARIZE=1" "-sEXPORT_NAME=createOIDNTest" "-sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1"
    "-sSTACK_SIZE=1048576" "-sENVIRONMENT=web")
else()
  add_executable(oidn_external_test external_test.cpp uniform_test.cpp)
  target_compile_features(oidn_external_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_definitions(oidn_external_test PRIVATE OIDN_WEBGPU_EXTERNAL_ONLY)
  target_include_directories(oidn_external_test PRIVATE ../.. "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/oidn" ../../external)
endif()
target_link_libraries(oidn_external_test PRIVATE OIDN::WebGPU_RT lt_webgpu)
if(WIN32)
  add_custom_command(TARGET oidn_external_test POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different $<TARGET_FILE:lt_webgpu> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:oidn_external_test>)
endif()
if(NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
  set(OIDN_TEST_WEIGHTS "" CACHE PATH "Directory of .tza models")
  set(OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES "" CACHE PATH "regression-data generated by tests/webgpu_browser.py")
  option(OIDN_TEST_F16 "Also compare FP16 against CPU fixtures (requires shader-f16)" OFF)
  enable_testing()
  if(OIDN_TEST_WEIGHTS AND OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES)
    foreach(case odd-srgb odd-hdr tiled-hdr)
      if(case STREQUAL "odd-srgb")
        set(mode srgb)
        set(model rt_ldr)
      else()
        set(mode hdr)
        set(model rt_hdr)
      endif()
      if(case STREQUAL "tiled-hdr")
        set(width 1024)
        set(height 1024)
      else()
        set(width 333)
        set(height 197)
      endif()
      add_test(NAME WebGPU.External.${case} COMMAND oidn_external_test
        "${OIDN_TEST_WEIGHTS}/${model}.tza" "${OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES}/${case}.bin"
        "${OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES}/${case}-cpu.bin" ${width} ${height} ${mode} f32)
      add_test(NAME WebGPU.External.Texture.${case} COMMAND oidn_external_test
        "${OIDN_TEST_WEIGHTS}/${model}.tza" "${OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES}/${case}.bin"
        "${OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES}/${case}-cpu.bin" ${width} ${height} ${mode} f32 texture)
      if(OIDN_TEST_F16)
        add_test(NAME WebGPU.External.FP16.${case} COMMAND oidn_external_test
          "${OIDN_TEST_WEIGHTS}/${model}.tza" "${OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES}/${case}.bin"
          "${OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES}/${case}-cpu.bin" ${width} ${height} ${mode} f16)
        add_test(NAME WebGPU.External.FP16.Texture.${case} COMMAND oidn_external_test
          "${OIDN_TEST_WEIGHTS}/${model}.tza" "${OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES}/${case}.bin"
          "${OIDN_TEST_FIXTURES}/${case}-cpu.bin" ${width} ${height} ${mode} f16 texture)
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endif()
endif()
